acceptance_criteria.description: Checked-in BMP source and experiment cardinality remains exact even when historical sources exist.
Historical catalog and observation rows are accepted only through explicit legacy origins and remain claim ineligible.
The structural test passes for both zero and nonzero historical import sets.
Focused ledger and historical import tests, collaboration validation, lab doctor, and diff checks pass.

objective: Replace empty-historical-ledger cardinality assumptions with structural assertions that independently validate BMP and legacy projections.
title: Make checked-in ledger tests import-aware
